name: condominio-saas
description: Plataforma SaaS multi-tenant para gestao de condominios

scripts.prepare: husky || echo 'husky ausente (instalacao sem devDependencies) - seguindo'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:deploy: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.docker:prune: docker system prune -f && docker volume prune -f
